scope: Exact staged snapshot plus credential-pattern/path/provenance review.
scanner: Gitleaks 8.24.3 default rules, full redaction, no ignore comments accepted; reports in ignored outputs/operation-contract-security/.

existing_dummy_credential_test_urls.classification: Unchanged explicit test literals for credential URL rejection; not real credentials.

new_evidence: Only contracts, synthetic/mocked validation receipts, audit and a real-model-unavailable receipt with zero cases. No raw responses, model weights, UCI CSV/archive, user uploads, private datasets or generated secrets included.
diagnostics: Off by default; byte-verified original synthetic fixture only; unknown/free text redacted. Never attached to public-bank or ordinary user workspaces.
public_bank_reader: Explicit caller file; published dimensions/vocabulary and size/nesting bounds, no ZIP path extraction, only job retained; failed source/model text not logged. Official download and CSV hash provide caller provenance, not independent remote-byte attestation.
local_only_and_SQL: Literal loopback, no redirects/cloud/tools/fallback; existing SQL AST, relationship, memory, time and approval guards retained. Engine, SQL Lab and metric compiler byte-identical to parent.
publication: Local commit only; no push, merge or deployment.
limits: Scanner plus path/provenance review, not proof about every possible secret.
